class EveryBlock private constructor(state: State) : Visible, Dynamic, CollisionDetector, Editable<EveryBlock>, KeyboardInputAware {

    /**

    override fun onAdded(kubriko: Kubriko) {
        actorManager = kubriko.get()
        viewportManager = kubriko.get()
        keyboardInputManager = kubriko.get()
        stateManager = kubriko.get()
        generatedScenes = kubriko.get()
        generatedAudio = kubriko.get()
        spriteManager = kubriko.get()
        everyManagerManager = kubriko.get()
        // When added to the Scene
        velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
        velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
        // Bounce off the edge only works in the Edge touched Event.
        isRemoved = true
        actorManager.remove(this)
        // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
        // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone", source = "EveryBlock")
        run {
            val speed = velocity.x
            if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
        }
        score = -1f
        score += 0.5f
        title = "Game \"over\""
        isShielded = false
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        // Choose a Property for this Block.
        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}", source = "EveryBlock")
        run {
            if (isShielded) score += 1f
        }
        actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (Random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}", source = "EveryBlock")
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        run {
            val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
            var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
            var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
            for (index in actors.indices) {
                val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                }
            }
            if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
        }
        // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
        timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
        timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
        spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
        spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
        timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
        // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
        // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
        if (score <= 3f) {
            repeat(2) {
                if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                    if (isShielded) {
                        if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                            if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                if (Random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                    if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                        if (false) {
                                            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                        } else {
                                            // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                            isRemoved = true
                                            actorManager.remove(this)
                                        }
                                        everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                        everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                        everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                        if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                            if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}", source = "EveryBlock")
                                                    run {
                                                        actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                    }
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                    generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                    // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                    generatedScenes.restart()
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                    stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                    generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                    // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                    generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                    // Choose music for this Block.
                                                    generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        body.position += velocity * (deltaTimeInMilliseconds.coerceAtMost(33) / 1000f)
        val box = body.axisAlignedBoundingBox
        val sceneSettings = generatedScenes.settings
        val topLeft = sceneSettings?.topLeft ?: viewportManager.topLeft.value
        val bottomRight = sceneSettings?.bottomRight ?: viewportManager.bottomRight.value
        val isTouchingLeftEdge = box.min.x < topLeft.x
        val isTouchingRightEdge = box.max.x > bottomRight.x
        val isTouchingTopEdge = box.min.y < topLeft.y
        val isTouchingBottomEdge = box.max.y > bottomRight.y
        if (isTouchingLeftEdge || isTouchingRightEdge || isTouchingTopEdge || isTouchingBottomEdge) {
            body.position += SceneOffset(
                if (isTouchingLeftEdge) topLeft.x - box.min.x else if (isTouchingRightEdge) bottomRight.x - box.max.x else SceneUnit.Zero,
                if (isTouchingTopEdge) topLeft.y - box.min.y else if (isTouchingBottomEdge) bottomRight.y - box.max.y else SceneUnit.Zero,
            )
            // When an edge of the screen is touched
            velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
            velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
            velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
            body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
            if (isTouchingLeftEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit, velocity.y)
            if (isTouchingRightEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(-velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit, velocity.y)
            if (isTouchingTopEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x, velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit)
            if (isTouchingBottomEdge) velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x, -velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit)
            isRemoved = true
            actorManager.remove(this)
            // Bounce off it only works in a collision Event.
            // Remove the other Actor only works in a collision Event.
            if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone", source = "EveryBlock")
            run {
                val speed = velocity.x
                if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
            }
            score = -1f
            score += 0.5f
            title = "Game \"over\""
            isShielded = false
            // Choose a Property for this Block.
            // Choose a Property for this Block.
            if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}", source = "EveryBlock")
            run {
                if (isShielded) score += 1f
            }
            actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
            // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
            // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
            // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
            run {
                val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
                var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
                var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
                for (index in actors.indices) {
                    val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                    if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                    val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                    val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                    if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                        nearest = candidate
                        nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                    }
                }
                if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
            }
            // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
            timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
            timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
            spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
            spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
            timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
            // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
            // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
            if (score <= 3f) {
                repeat(2) {
                    if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                        if (isShielded) {
                            if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                                if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                    if (Random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                        if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                            if (false) {
                                                velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                            } else {
                                                // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                                isRemoved = true
                                                actorManager.remove(this)
                                            }
                                            everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                            everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                            everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                            // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                            // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                            if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                                if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                    if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}", source = "EveryBlock")
                                                        run {
                                                            actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                        }
                                                        generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                        generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                        // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                        generatedScenes.restart()
                                                        stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                        stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                        stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                        generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                        generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                        // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                        generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                        generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                        // Choose music for this Block.
                                                        generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        collisionMask.position = bodyCenter
        collisionMask.rotation = body.rotation
    }

    override fun onKeyPressed(key: Key) {
        if (!stateManager.isRunning.value) return
        when (key) {
            Key.DirectionLeft -> {
                velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
                velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
                velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
                // Bounce off the edge only works in the Edge touched Event.
                isRemoved = true

                                                        }
                                                    }

                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Key.DirectionDown -> {
                if (keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.DirectionDown)) {
                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "Held", source = "EveryBlock")
                }
            }
            Key.Spacebar -> {

    override fun onCollisionDetected(collidables: List<Collidable>) {
        if (isRemoved) return
        for (index in collidables.indices) {
            when (val other = collidables[index]) {
                is EveryBlock -> if (!other.isRemoved) {
                    velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
                    velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
                    velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                    body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
                    // Bounce off the edge only works in the Edge touched Event.
                    isRemoved = true
                    actorManager.remove(this)
                    bounceOff(other)
                    other.isRemoved = true
                    actorManager.remove(other)
                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone", source = "EveryBlock")
                    run {
                        val speed = velocity.x
                        if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                    }
                    score = -1f
                    score += 0.5f
                    title = "Game \"over\""
                    isShielded = false
                    // Choose a Property for this Block.
                    // Choose a Property for this Block.
                    if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}", source = "EveryBlock")
                    run {
                        if (isShielded) score += 1f
                    }
                    actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                    run {
                        val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
                        var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
                        var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
                        for (index in actors.indices) {
                            val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                            if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                            val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                            val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                            if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                                nearest = candidate
                                nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                            }
                        }
                        if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
                    }
                    // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                    timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
                    timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                    spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
                    spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
                    timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
                    // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
                    // End only works after an if or repeat Block.
                    if (score <= 3f) {
                        repeat(2) {
                            if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                                if (isShielded) {
                                    if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                                        if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                            if (Random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                                if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                                    if (false) {
                                                        velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                                    } else {
                                                        // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                                        isRemoved = true
                                                        actorManager.remove(this)
                                                    }
                                                    everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                                    everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                                    everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                                    // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                    // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                    if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                                        if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                            if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                                if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}", source = "EveryBlock")
                                                                run {
                                                                    actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                                }
                                                                generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                                generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                                // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                                generatedScenes.restart()
                                                                stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                                stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                                stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                                generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                                generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                                // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                                generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                                generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                                // Choose music for this Block.
                                                                generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                                velocity = SceneOffset(1.5f.sceneUnit, -2f.sceneUnit)
                                                                velocity += SceneOffset(1.0E-4f.sceneUnit, 3f.sceneUnit)
                                                                velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                                                body.position = SceneOffset(-10f.sceneUnit, 10f.sceneUnit)
                                                                // Bounce off the edge only works in the Edge touched Event.
                                                                isRemoved = true
                                                                actorManager.remove(this)
                                                                bounceOff(other)
                                                                other.isRemoved = true
                                                                actorManager.remove(other)
                                                                if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone", source = "EveryBlock")
                                                                run {
                                                                    val speed = velocity.x
                                                                    if (speed > 0f.sceneUnit) velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                                                }
                                                                score = -1f
                                                                score += 0.5f
                                                                title = "Game \"over\""
                                                                isShielded = false
                                                                // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                                // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                                if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${title}: ${score.asText()} (${isShielded}) {missing}", source = "EveryBlock")
                                                                run {
                                                                    if (isShielded) score += 1f
                                                                }
                                                                actorManager.add(EveryBlock.metadata.instantiate(body.position + SceneOffset(10f.sceneUnit, -5f.sceneUnit)).restore())
                                                                // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                                // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                                // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                                run {
                                                                    val actors = actorManager.allActors.value
                                                                    var nearest: EveryBlock? = null
                                                                    var nearestDistanceSquared = Float.MAX_VALUE
                                                                    for (index in actors.indices) {
                                                                        val candidate = actors[index] as? EveryBlock ?: continue
                                                                        if (candidate === this || candidate.isRemoved) continue
                                                                        val offset = candidate.body.position - body.position
                                                                        val distanceSquared = offset.x.raw * offset.x.raw + offset.y.raw * offset.y.raw
                                                                        if (distanceSquared < nearestDistanceSquared) {
                                                                            nearest = candidate
                                                                            nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                                                                        }
                                                                    }
                                                                    if (nearest != null) velocity = (nearest.body.position - body.position).normalized() * 200f
                                                                }
                                                                // Choose an Actor type for this Block.
                                                                timer1RemainingInMilliseconds = 250
                                                                timer1PeriodInMilliseconds = 0
                                                                spawnEnemyRemainingInMilliseconds = 2000
                                                                spawnEnemyPeriodInMilliseconds = 2000
                                                                timer2RemainingInMilliseconds = 0
                                                                // Give this Block's Timer a name made of letters and digits.
                                                            }
                                                            if (score <= 3f) {
                                                                repeat(2) {
                                                                    if (title != "Say \"\$hi\"") {
                                                                        if (isShielded) {
                                                                            if (!keyboardInputManager.isKeyPressed(Key.Spacebar)) {
                                                                                if (velocity.y != -1.5f.sceneUnit) {
                                                                                    if (Random.nextFloat() * 100f < 12.5f) {
                                                                                        if (stateManager.isRunning.value) {
                                                                                            if (false) {
                                                                                                velocity = SceneOffset.Zero
                                                                                            } else {
                                                                                                // Else only works once, after an if Block.
                                                                                                isRemoved = true
                                                                                                actorManager.remove(this)
                                                                                            }
                                                                                            everyManagerManager.score += 2f
                                                                                            everyManagerManager.title = "Hi"
                                                                                            everyManagerManager.isShielded = true
                                                                                            // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                                                            // Choose a Property for this Block.
                                                                                            if (everyManagerManager.score > 1f) {
                                                                                                if (everyManagerManager.title == "") {
                                                                                                    if (everyManagerManager.isShielded) {
                                                                                                        if (KubrikoWiring.isLoggingEnabled) Logger.log(message = "${everyManagerManager.score.asText()} ${everyManagerManager.title} ${everyManagerManager.isShielded} {Missing.score} {EveryManager.missing}", source = "EveryBlock")
                                                                                                        run {
                                                                                                            actorManager.allActors.value.size
                                                                                                        }
                                                                                                        generatedScenes.goTo("main")
                                                                                                        generatedScenes.goTo("missing")
                                                                                                        // Choose a Scene for this Block.
                                                                                                        generatedScenes.restart()
                                                                                                        stateManager.updateIsRunning(false)
                                                                                                        stateManager.updateIsRunning(true)
                                                                                                        stateManager.updateIsRunning(!stateManager.isRunning.value)
                                                                                                        generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/hit.wav")
                                                                                                        generatedAudio.playSound("files/sounds/say \"\$hi\".wav")
                                                                                                        // Choose a sound for this Block.
                                                                                                        generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/theme.mp3")
                                                                                                        generatedAudio.playMusic("files/music/win.mp3", isLooping = false)
                                                                                                        // Choose music for this Block.
                                                                                                        generatedAudio.stopMusic()
                                                                                                    }
                                                                                                }
                                                                                            }
                                                                                        }
                                                                                    }
                                                                                }
                                                                            }
                                                                        }
                                                                    }
                                                                }
                                                            }
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Turns the velocity away from [other], on the axis they overlap less on.
     */
    private fun bounceOff(other: Visible) {
        val offset = body.position - other.body.position
        if (offset.x.raw.absoluteValue * (body.size.height + other.body.size.height).raw >= offset.y.raw.absoluteValue * (body.size.width + other.body.size.width).raw) {
            velocity = SceneOffset(if (offset.x > SceneUnit.Zero) velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit else -velocity.x.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit, velocity.y)
        } else {
            velocity = SceneOffset(velocity.x, if (offset.y > SceneUnit.Zero) velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit else -velocity.y.raw.absoluteValue.sceneUnit)
        }
    }

    override fun DrawScope.draw() {
        val image = sprite?.let { spriteManager.get(it) } ?: return
        drawImage(
            image = image,
            dstSize = IntSize(body.size.width.raw.roundToInt(), body.size.height.raw.roundToInt()),
            filterQuality = FilterQuality.None,
        )
    }

    private fun Float.asText() = if (this % 1f == 0f) toLong().toString() else toString()

    override fun save() = State(
        body = body,
        color = color,
        score = score,
        title = title,
        isShielded = isShielded,
        every = every,
    )

    @kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
    data class State(
        @SerialName("body") val body: SerializableBoxBody = BoxBody(),
        @SerialName("color") val color: SerializableColor = Color(0xFF6060AA),
        @SerialName("score") val score: Float = 2.5f,
        @SerialName("title") val title: String = "Say \"\$hi\" \\ to\neveryone",
        @SerialName("isShielded") val isShielded: Boolean = true,
        @SerialName("every") val every: Float = 0f,
    ) : Serializable.State<EveryBlock> {

        override fun restore() = EveryBlock(this)

        override fun serialize() = Json.encodeToString(this)
    }

    companion object {
        private val sprite = Res.allDrawableResources["every_block"]

        val metadata = EditableMetadata.create<EveryBlock, State>(typeId = "EveryBlock") { position ->
            State(body = BoxBody(initialPosition = position, initialSize = SceneSize(80f.sceneUnit, 80f.sceneUnit)))
        }
    }
}
